spanish: Cuando da varón a su compañero asno o buey o cordero y toda bestia a guardar, y muere o es quebrado o capturado, no hay vidente,

findings.issue: cordero narrows שֶׂה to a young sheep; the token is one flock animal, singular, common gender, with no age or species.
vidente turns the qal active participle (one who sees) into a seer/visionary.
Cuando fixes the conjunction as temporal; morphology only marks conjunction.
Imperfect and perfects are rendered as present; person, number, and niphal passive stay intact.
findings.spanishSpan: da … muere o es quebrado o capturado

notes: Man, his companion, ass, ox, and-all beast, to keep, and the existential negative match the tokens.
